blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Over 200 individuals were arrested for participating in illegal demonstrations in Barangay Sucat, Muntinlupa, according to Southern Police District (SPD) Director Brig. Gen. Rodel Pastor. “They conducted a protest rally in Barangay Sucat, Muntinlupa, wherein it is not a freedom park and without permit, daming naabala kasi nabarahan ang kalsada, daming apektadong mamamaya at commuters,” Pastor told the Inquirer in a Viber message on Sunday.
